title: Exercise 3. Command card
html:
1. Give linear.x and angular.z (all other fields zero) to drive backward at 0.1 m/s.
  2. Write the values to turn right on the spot at 0.4 rad/s.
  3. Write the values to stop.
  4. Describe in words what (linear.x, angular.z) = (0.15, +0.3) asks the robot to do.
  5. In the ideal model the robot turns at exactly +0.4 rad/s. How long does it take to turn 90 degrees to the left?
